value.rationale: The focal result exhibits failure of typical periodic optimization through one robust aperiodic potential. The accepted theorem identifies an explicit unbounded convex two-parameter region, quantifies the tradeoff between its two natural defects, and recovers the published diagonal radius as a slice. This is a structural description of the exceptional nonperiodic region, not a renaming or routine numerical variant.
